Class BackendTests

java.lang.Object
backendTests.BackendTests
public final class BackendTests extends Object

Title: BackendTests Class.

Description: Semi-automated TP2 backend requirement tests (VG01-10). Each named PASS line asserts the stored outcome; a failed assertion throws and exits nonzero. Fixtures use private temporary file-backed H2 databases and registered/authenticated users, never production data. Requirement identifiers map to Contributor Phase Two stories in Backend_Requirements.md.

    • concurrentLockChecks

      private static void concurrentLockChecks(String url, int id) throws Exception
      VG03/VG04/VG05: another connection locks a lesson while a stale write is waiting. A timeout proves the operation waits on the row; after commit it must reject the write. These tests expose check-then-write races that sequential GUI validation cannot detect.
      Throws:
      Exception
